title: y5em.2: migrate legacy authorize_mutating_result callers to the expanded form and delete the shim
description: Child 2 of y5em (after y5em.1 renames the legacy generation to coap_oscore_authorize_mutating_result): migrate the 13 legacy call sites to the EXPANDED 12-arg form (coap_oscore_authorize_mutating: resource, request, addr, addr_len, expected_method, plain_buf, plain_buf_len, &payload_out, &payload_len_out, &ctx_out, piv_out, &piv_len_out, &is_protected - see header :270 docs and checkin_resource.c:159 for the canonical usage) and then DELETE the legacy declaration + definition. Per-file census (worker-1): coap_msg.c 6, coap_waypoints.c 2, coap_config.c 2, checkin_resource.c 1, coap_rangetest.c 1, coap_slot_coord.c 1. Migration per site: declare local uint8_t plain_buf[...], const uint8_t *payload; uint16_t payload_len; struct oscore_ctx *ctx; uint8_t piv[OSCORE_PIV_MAX_LEN]; size_t piv_len; bool is_protected; call the expanded gate; adapt downstream uses (result->payload -> payload/payload_len; result->ctx/is_protected/piv equivalents). Preserve each resource's response-code behavior exactly (the gate returns a CoAP response code to propagate). VERIFY: tests/coap_slot_claim host build + every touched resource's host test if present + native_sim sweep on heft when available. NOTE: y5em.1's rename makes the tree compile; this child finishes the cleanup and removes the shim. Coordinate with the oev1/7nnl family only if response semantics change (they must not).
